_comment: Lane B step 1 - ToonCrafter inbetweening between two locked canon keyframes. Adapted from ComfyUI-DynamiCrafterWrapper examples/tooncrafter_example_low_vram_01.json (author's own graph) with KJNodes helpers replaced by ComfyUI core nodes (ImageScale/ImageBatch) to cut kernel dependencies. Model: pruned FP16 checkpoint (Kijai/DynamiCrafter_pruned, sha256 in STAGING-MANIFEST). steps=50 = the official repo's DDIM setting (the wrapper example uses 20 for speed). Output 16 frames @ 512x320, 8fps; double to 16fps with Practical-RIFE downstream. Keyframes must be prepped to 512x320 white-field canvases by tools/prep_keyframes.py; the ImageScale nodes are a guard, not the composition step. Node signatures verified against the cloned wrapper source (nodes.py) 2026-10-28.
